MEETING CALLED TO ORDER

Date / Time:  March 27, 2023 / 3:00 PM

IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Lili Bosse, Councilmember Sharona Nazarian, Arts and Culture
  Commissioner Deborah Frank, Arts and Culture Commissioner Pamela
  Beck, City Manager Nancy Hunt-Coffey, Director of Community Services
  Stephanie Harris, Assistant Director of Community Services Patty Acuna,
  Interim Arts and Culture Manager Paul Paolone, Arts and Culture Program
  Associate Aida Thau, Community Services Manager Magdalena Davis,
  Associate Project Manager Ji Kim, Office Assistant Brandy Scott

  Attendees via zoom: Management Assistant Linda Kyriazi, Recreation
  Supervisor Corrina Lesser, RLA staff Nelson Hallonquist and Christina
  Varvi

1)  PUBLIC COMMENT
  Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the Committee on
  any item listed on the agenda.

  •  No public comment

2)  RECOMMENDATION BY THE ARTS AND CULTURE COMMISSION AND CITY STAFF
  TO SUPPORT THE UPDATED INFORMATION PERTAINING TO THE ACQUISITION
  AND INSTALLATION OF THE ARTWORK TRINITY BY JUDY CHICAGO.
  Arts and Culture Program Associate, Aida Thau, provided a presentation with updated
  information that relates to the acquisition of the sculpture Trinity by Judy Chicago. In the
  interest of the longevity and protection of the piece being displayed outdoors, a concrete
  base has been added by the artist to the design and installation of this artwork.

  Seeking approval on the proposed integral color concrete base designed by the artist, the
  recommended installation site on City Hall campus, Beverly Gardens Park as the
  alternative site, and the allocation of additional funds from the Fine Art Fund to cover the
  corresponding ancillary costs.
  .

3)  FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
